messages.text:
"I want a 1v1 moba in which you build a five man team, set logic for each character, and can switch controlthrough characters at will. Bad teammates are the bane of all Moba games. 
Character roster- 
Aelia the fury. She wields two daggers and stealth attacks. Redhead with green eyes and messy hair. She's absolutely feral. Special skill is to go invisible and stun an opponent upon reactivation, and raise her attack speed to triple when attacking a stunned opponent. While her attack speed is tripled, her defense is halved. 
Teneia the tank. Can root every opponent within range, but roots herself as well, but her defense triples while she's rooted. The range is about the same range as a tower's in League of Legends. 
Oola is a jungler. She's a dog woman who has the passive ability to detect jungle creatures from farther away, as well as enemy players. Her awareness of enemies is twice everyone else's and players can't hide in grass around her. Only an activated special ability to hide can hide from her. Also she does double damage from tall grass. Her active skill is maul, she ferociously attacks. But it has less effect on players.
Build a roster with balance in mind. Also should be able to be played solo. We'll add the multiplayer later. The battleground is a ruined city.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable solo-character-based MOBA prototype in the browser for a ruined-city battleground, with a five-hero team, per-character logic, and direct hero switching.

## Requirements
- Five-character roster with distinct roles and abilities, balanced for solo play.
- One-vs-one-style skirmish structure, but with a five-man team under player control.
- Ability to switch control between heroes at will.
- Ruined city map and solo-compatible gameplay.
- “Bad teammates are the bane” design: player sets logic for each ally instead of relying on teammates.
- No multiplayer required for this build.
- “Build a complete, playable game now” and do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Assumed this is a single-player, AI-controlled enemy skirmish prototype rather than networked multiplayer.
- Built the initial version as a self-contained browser game in `index.html` with a UI, battlefield, hero roster, enemy wave logic, and core/tower combat loop.
- Chosen battle design: switch active hero with `1-5`, use WASD movement, SPACE attack, Q skill, and click-to-move/focus target.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a browser-based playable solo MOBA prototype in `index.html`.
- Added a five-hero roster: Aelia, Teneia, Oola, Brann, and Mira.
- Implemented per-character logic switching and ability system.
- Added ruined-city battlefield rendering, towers/cores, AI enemies, and basic combat loop.
- Added UI panels for squad selection, combat feed, and objective bars.

### Active
- Verifying and tuning the prototype’s gameplay balance and polish in `index.html`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game locally to confirm the browser prototype loads and the combat loop works end-to-end.
2. Fix any gameplay, UI, or logic defects revealed by runtime testing.
3. Tune hero balance, skill timing, and enemy difficulty for a fair solo experience.
4. If needed, add further polish for the ruined-city aesthetic and clearer MOBA objectives.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: playable solo MOBA prototype and game logic.

## Important Context
- The user’s requested roster includes Aelia (stealth/stun/frenzy), Teneia (root + self-root tank), and Oola (jungle scout/vision/grass damage), and the current prototype implements those concepts as a playable solo skirmish.
- The current build is a self-contained browser game; no multiplayer or external assets were added.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser-based solo MOBA prototype set in a ruined city, with a five-hero team, configurable ally logic, and on-demand hero switching.

## Requirements
- Five-character team with balanced, distinct roles and abilities; player can switch control at will.
- Solo-compatible 1v1-style skirmish against AI; no multiplayer for this build.
- Allies follow player-configurable logic.
- Ruined-city battleground.
- Roster concepts include Aelia’s stealth/stun/frenzy, Teneia’s area root and defensive boost, and Oola’s jungle/enemy detection and tall-grass damage.
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained browser game in `index.html`, with an AI-controlled opposing team.
- Controls planned: WASD movement, SPACE attack, Q ability, 1–5 hero switching, and click-to-move/focus.
- Game presentation is titled “ASHEN CROWN” and set in the “Ruins of Veyra.”

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial HTML/CSS interface, roster data, squad-logic controls, intro overlay, HUD, and objective/feed panels in `index.html`.
- Added partial simulation logic for heroes, enemies, abilities, minions, towers, and cores.

### Active
- Finish and verify `index.html`; current file is incomplete and is not yet a playable game.

### Blocked
- The latest edit leaves `index.html` ending after `update(dt)`; drawing functions, input/event wiring, deployment/pause controls, animation loop, and closing script/document markup still need to be added.

## Next Move
1. Complete `index.html` with canvas rendering, resize/input handling, deploy and pause actions, and the requestAnimationFrame loop.
2. Check for gameplay logic defects and ensure objectives can be won or lost.
3. Run the game in a browser and fix runtime or UI issues.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: current partial game implementation; primary file to continue.

## Important Context
- A prior version had more complete rendering and interaction code, but the latest write replaced it with a new partial implementation; do not assume those functions remain in the file.
- No verification or gameplay test has been recorded.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete a playable solo browser MOBA prototype set in the ruined city of Veyra, with five switchable heroes and configurable ally logic.

## Requirements
- Five distinct heroes; player can switch control at will and configure ally behavior.
- Solo skirmish against an AI-controlled opposing team; no multiplayer.
- Ruined-city battlefield; include Aelia’s stealth/stun/frenzy, Teneia’s area root/defense, and Oola’s jungle detection/grass damage.

## Decisions
- Implement the game as a self-contained `index.html` titled “ASHEN CROWN,” set in the “Ruins of Veyra.”
- Use WASD movement, SPACE attack, Q ability, 1–5 hero switching, and canvas clicks for movement or target focus.

## Work State
### Completed
- Completed the interface, five-hero roster, configurable squad logic, battlefield rendering, combat simulation, abilities, minion waves, towers, cores, and win/loss handling in `index.html`.
- Added deployment, pause/resume, keyboard and pointer input, HUD updates, and animation loop.
- Checked JavaScript syntax with `node --check`; loaded the page in headless Chromium and captured a screenshot.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Manually playtest combat, controls, pause/redeploy, and victory/defeat flows; fix any issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete browser game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is currently untracked.
- Browser verification confirmed initial rendering, but a full interactive gameplay test has not been recorded.
